chosen.note: The realistic cohort's rhythm, premature ectopic beats and annotation-noisy labels, with recorded MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test noise (baseline wander, electrode motion, muscle artifact) at NSTDB's SNR levels instead of invented artifacts.
chosen.source_note: Realistic synthetic cohort with recorded noise — eight synthetic clients with variable rhythm, ectopic beats and annotation-noisy labels, over recorded NSTDB baseline wander, electrode motion and muscle artifact.

live.sentence: Realistic synthetic ECG with RECORDED noise (MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test baseline wander, electrode motion and muscle artifact at NSTDB signal-to-noise levels) on eight logical clients on one machine: variable rhythm, premature ectopic beats with pauses, and annotation-noisy labels. The ECG is still synthetic: no real physiology.
